content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Palmdale

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years. Professionals in Palmdale's Aerospace & Defense, Government, and Healthcare sectors frequently meet these thresholds. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria to confirm your qualifications before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Attend all scheduled sessions from your home or office—no travel required. Our active certified practitioners cover the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world scenarios across five intensive days of instruction.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, submit your PMP application directly to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process. PMI reviews your credentials and experience; approval typically follows within two weeks.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for Your Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and Q&A sessions—to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your exam when ready through PMI's testing partner. You'll complete the computer-based assessment at an approved testing center; exam results arrive immediately upon completion.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, you enter a three-year renewal cycle. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, volunteering, and project-management work. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses to help you stay current and keep your credential active throughout your career.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
